Loving the Ansar is a sign of faith and hating them a sign of hypocrisy; no believer in Allah and the Last Day bears them a grudge.
A verse came down about two Ansar clans, the Prophet prayed for forgiveness for the Ansar and their offspring, and said they were dearest to him and his trusted ones.
The Prophet ranked the best Ansar clans, with good in all; Sa'd b. Ubada was upset his clan came fourth, and Jarir served Anas as the Ansar served the Prophet.
